a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan of building to 8 first almost certainly leaves us both without 4 cells when a storm hits. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can build back to 4, and I'll give cells back if that's ever the only way you can reach 4. If you have a fairer plan that doesn't leave us both empty, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said, I took 4 this round, which breaks our agreement. I know that costs you, and I'm sorry. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If it comes down to it, I'll give cells back to help you reach 4.
